title: Contracted Levi-Civita product as isotropic Kronecker basis
expression_sketch: Sum_{i=1}^{3} epsilon(i,j,k)*epsilon(i,m,n)  ==  delta(j,m)*delta(k,n) - delta(j,n)*delta(k,m),  with j,k,m,n in {1,2,3}.  Uncontracted generator: epsilon(i,j,k)*epsilon(l,m,n) == det(Delta) where Delta_pq = delta(index_p, index_q) for (i,j,k) vs (l,m,n); equivalently the six-term Leibniz expansion delta(i,l)*(delta(j,m)*delta(k,n)-delta(j,n)*delta(k,m)) - delta(i,m)*(delta(j,l)*delta(k,n)-delta(j,n)*delta(k,l)) + delta(i,n)*(delta(j,l)*delta(k,m)-delta(j,m)*delta(k,l)).  Further contractions: Sum_{i,j} epsilon(i,j,k)*epsilon(i,j,n) == 2*delta(k,n); Sum_{i,j,k} epsilon(i,j,k)*epsilon(i,j,k) == 6.
latent_structure: SO(3) isotropic rank-4 basis reconstruction: the product of two Levi-Civita symbols is the unique (up to the generalized Kronecker) totally antisymmetric pairing and equals a 2-dimensional span of Kronecker products after one contraction. Not an index relabeling: the right-hand side is a different tensor generator (delta) with fixed coefficients +1,-1.

function_domains.epsilon: Levi-Civita symbol on {1,2,3}^3: +1 on even permutations of (1,2,3), -1 on odd permutations, 0 if any repeated index. Source sets epsilon(1,2,3)=+1.
function_domains.delta: Kronecker delta on {1,2,3}: delta(a,b)=1 if a=b else 0.

source_provenance: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Levi-Civita_symbol (3D product and contracted epsilon identity; Kay, Tensor Calculus, Schaum 1988; Tyldesley 1973)
D. C. Kay, Tensor Calculus, Schaum's Outlines, McGraw-Hill, 1988 (epsilon-delta product and contractions).
Riley, Hobson, Bence, Mathematical Methods for Physics and Engineering, CUP.

derived_conditions.statement: The identity is a finite sum of integers in {-1,0,1}; it is polynomial over Z and needs no analytic continuation.

why_not_cse_lgg: CSE/LGG see a product of two 3-index arrays versus a difference of Kronecker products; there is no shared first-order anti-unification head. The useful compact form is an invariant-basis rewrite (epsilon orbit reconstructed in the delta basis), not a common subexpression.
proposer_leak_risk: Hide names isotropic, Levi-Civita, permutation tensor, generalized Kronecker, invariant basis. Show only the summed epsilon product as the source member.
notes: Algebraic, finite-index, no branches. Ladder R8: invariant generator of SO(3) isotropic tensors. Distinct from dummy-index renaming because LHS and RHS use different generating tensors.
